description: Post a task: create a declared bounty market for ANY work domain (code, social-media, writing, research, data, other). Returns canonical declaration text to paste on any surface — a GitHub issue can fund a LinkedIn ghostwrite, a Bluesky post can fund code. Feed scanners bind the post to the market. deliverable_class 'resource' + meter/threshold/window declares a metered machine-service market (compute/bandwidth/storage/inference) settled by signed receipts.

adjudicator_x25519_pubkeys.description: D3b adjudicator collective — declared juror x25519 pubkeys (≤16). Each needs a spec_sealed_adjudicators_b64 copy; workers seal deliverables to all of them (ciphertext_adjudicators_b64). Operators judge instead of the bridge.

capacity.description: REQUIRED MORE capacity objective — every market declares its life-capacity dims + evidence plan

confidential.description: Confidential market — spec never leaves private KV; public surfaces carry domain+amount+specHash only. Requires funder_x25519_pubkey.

funder_x25519_pubkey.description: Funder's x25519 pubkey (64 hex) — sealed deliverables encrypt to it. Generate a fresh pair per market.

reveal_endpoint.description: Funder-run HTTPS reveal service — delegates reveals so the bridge stays blind (bridge cannot judge these markets)

spec_cid.description: IPFS CID of the sealed spec ciphertext bundle

spec_hash.description: sha256:<64hex> of the plaintext spec — binds the on-chain market

spec_sealed.description: D3 funder-sealed spec — encrypt client-side, the bridge NEVER receives plaintext. Requires spec_hash + (spec_sealed_bridge_b64 for bridge-judged markets, or reveal_endpoint for fully bridge-blind). Omit spec.

spec_sealed_adjudicators_b64.description: pubkey → crypto_box_seal(spec, that juror's x25519 pubkey) — one copy per declared adjudicator

spec_sealed_bridge_b64.description: crypto_box_seal(spec, bridge x25519 pubkey) — lets the bridge serve reveals + judge, in-request decrypt only

name: wide_bounty_declare
